Liquidity is tight (current ratio 1.18) and leverage is very high, with shareholders’ equity of only about 3–4% of total assets (5,987M equity vs. 164,787M assets), which limits balance-sheet resilience. Profitability also appears weak relative to scale (EBIT/operating income 446M vs. revenue 22,217M, ~2% margin), increasing vulnerability to operating stress. Overall, these factors point to a speculative-grade profile with elevated credit risk.

DECISION: B+
